answer: Each new key receives a 16-epoch stream of 96 signed microtasks, six per epoch, sampled from a public corpus only after commitment. Validators replay eight random tasks and compare intermediate activation sketches; keys sharing 7 of 8 rare error paths are merged. A shale wall may carry a signal or a whisper, but every extra fake needs 96 fresh executions, so 1,000 clones require 96,000 runs. Reused sketches erase rewards, while two failed replays freeze the cluster for six epochs and slash its 80-credit execution bond.
